ModMetaData.name: RimMind - Core
ModMetaData.author: mcocdaa
ModMetaData.description: Infrastructure for AI-powered RimWorld mods. Provides LLM client, async request queue, game context builders, and debug tooling. Required by all RimMind suite components. v2.0 uses a three-DLL loading architecture (0_RimMindDomain, 1_RimMindApplication, 2_RimMindCore) for modular assembly loading. [v2.0 BREAKING CHANGES] Save games from v1.x are NOT compatible with v2.0.
